title: Cerulean Analytics
text:
Cerulean Analytics

notes:
Summary: high-volume embeddings + reranking for real-time trading signals. Primary ask: sub-10ms per-query latency for rerank, embedding refresh cadence 1-2x/day.
AE notes: heavy focus on unit economics. Finance ran rough model: hosted per-token + per-embedding costs come out ~3x what they expect vs. existing in-house GPU cluster (capital already spent).
POC: 3-week eval (embeddings + rerank benchmark) completed 2024-05-10. Technical results: Redwood's latency and accuracy hit targets; cost per 1M queries ~ $1,100 projected for hosted API profile.
Security: legal and infosec demanded VPC/private deployment and key control. Redwood Dedicated looked ok but required 3x the committed spend they were comfortable with.
Quote from Head of ML: 'Performance is great — the numbers just don't match our finance model. We can't justify the commit size.'
Sales timeline/bullets:
- 2024-02-14: Intro call (AE Maya) — high-level use cases, agreed to run cost model.
- 2024-03-07: Tech deep-dive (SE Carlos) — infra, expected QPS, data residency needs.
- 2024-04-01: POC kickoff — test corpus and rerank workload provisioned.
- 2024-05-10: POC results shared — performance OK; detailed cost calc attached.
- 2024-05-18: Procurement/Finance review — flagged commit size and unit economics mismatch.
- 2024-05-22: Final decision call — Cerulean chose to pause and extend current in-house infra; vendor X offered a lower short-term price tied to longer-term lock-in.
Actionable takeaways:
- Primary reason lost: unit economics (token/embedding pricing + dedicated commit size) vs. sunk-cost advantage of in-house cluster.
- Secondary: no clear internal champion to push larger budget increase; CFO instituted hiring and spend freeze across projects for Q3.
- Security asked for air-gapped option for certain datasets — increased project complexity and cost.
Next outreach plan: re-engage after budget cycle (target Oct 2024). Consider 'migration path' materials showing 12–18 month TCO comparison vs. capex cluster and a lower-commit pilot pricing option.
Stubs/links: POC report (drive), pricing appendix, ff transcript id above. Jira INF-1129 captured a small bug during POC (kv-cache mismatch) — fixed during run but noted by ML infra team.
CRM tone: terse, realistic. Keep in follow-up cadence but deprioritize until budget reopens.
